concept.anti_generic_signature: The exact numerical axolotl-dragon silhouette: six notched coral gills setting133 mm width, low four-paw stance, eight rising mint barrels and a five-lobed fan reaching Z93.
assumptions: The Wish numerical dimensions are the reference; no image is attached and no image-verified replica claim is made.
Legs are fixed. Joint bend target is one-sided upward25 degrees and twist target20 degrees; a full all-direction25-degree cone is not promised.
8 by1 mm disc magnet geometry is the specified envelope after a reachable catalog search miss; no supplier STEP or magnetic holding-force specification is claimed.
Adhesive permanently joins construction seams, color inserts and magnet seats; articulated joints themselves are snap assembled.
Frictions pads intentionally interfere .075 mm radially; rigid overlap allowances must name that contact and never hide unrelated collisions.

All head/face designs have sealed isolated and current production native passes; pocket pattern and static assembly evidence recorded. Applied0.05mm adhesive film remains a physical assumption. Motion UNVERIFIED; cancelled face withdrawal has no verdict; magnetic hold/adhesion untested.

All accessory designs have sealed isolated and current production native passes; exact current figure envelope and neutral static check recorded. Belly08 bonds only on its forward backed half. No physical bond, print readiness or moving-pose qualification.
